scope_outcomes.criterion: Paths returning to a starting variable through separately supported links, with missing or conditional return edges identified.
scope_outcomes.basis: The paper names a cyclical myth process and supports a conditional reinforcing diffusion–competition–application path plus a broader decline-to-renewal path.
limitations: Closure of the reinforcing diffusion loop depends on successful communication of new applications.
The broad myth cycle is categorical and historically transformative, not a fully signed formal loop.
